## Bunker 0.6.0 – a face for the big screen 👽

### FACE, a second visualizer
- **FACE** (<kbd>O</kbd>, the mask button in the top bar) puts a low-poly alien head in space for your projector, next to the light show, which is now called **LIGHTS** (<kbd>P</kbd>).
- It nods on every beat, its slit-pupilled eyes dart around and stare at you, and now and then its black slit of a mouth stretches into a grin full of needle teeth.
- In a build-up it glitches, splits into red and blue, nods twice as fast and its mouth starts to tear open.
- On the drop it rushes at you and screams with sharp fangs and lasers blazing from its eyes. Then cracks glow through its face, it bursts into shards that fly out of the picture, and it pulls itself back together.

### A clearer top bar
- **ORBIT | CLASSIC** switches the view, and the one you're in is filled. The pads and step grid are now called **Classic**.
- The record button is **red** all the time.
- A gear opens the **settings**: volume, sound output, MIDI keyboard and the update check.

### Easier to read
- An effect lights up when Bunker uses it by itself. The gate flickers through every build-up.
- In a break, a track the energy takes out says **OUT** next to its name.
- **Every track is one bar**, so the loop-length button is gone. Shorter loops in older files are written out as their repeats and sound the same.
- **Change every** only shows while the auto mode runs.
- The output level is a thin light along the edge of the space window.
- The sound sliders are now bars instead of knobs, with more contrast all round.

### And
- Right-click a step, in the orbit or in Classic, for its menu: on, accent, slide, how often it plays and, on bass and synth, its note.
- Bunker always starts in its window, even if you quit it inside a visualizer.
- The first start is Hypnotic and waits for you to press play.

### Downloads

- **macOS 11+** (Apple Silicon & Intel): `Bunker-macos-universal.zip`
- **Windows 10/11:** `Bunker-windows-x64.zip`

The Mac app is not notarized yet: on first launch, right-click → *Open*, or *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway*. Windows SmartScreen may ask once: *More info → Run anyway*.
